sectionTitle: Cosmic Origin, Causation, and Temporal Boundaries

lockedMove.speaker: Victor Stenger
lockedMove.excerpt: cosmology since the 1980s reputable cosmologists have published papers and reputable scientific journals proposing scenarios by which the universe could have come about naturally one plausible mechanism is a wellestablished process called Quantum tunneling our universe could have tunneled from a prior state of complete chaos and possibly through that region of chaos from an earlier Universe in my 2006 book The comprehensible Cosmos you'll find the scenario worked out completely mathematically from well-known principles the physics and cosmology that proof is accessible to anyone who has studied undergraduate math and physics again this is not my uh personal invention but taken from peer-reviewed literature
lockedMove.proposition: Published quantum-tunneling scenarios show that a natural cosmic origin is consistent with known physics without invoking God.
